Reason: The CT images demonstrate extensive pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema extending into the neck (Figures 1-3), with air clearly visible within the spinal canal. Pneumorrhachis in this context is best explained by air tracking from the mediastinum/retropharyngeal space through the cervical neural exit foramina into the epidural space, rather than direct trauma, esophageal perforation, or isolated findings.
